description: Click an element or fill a field by CSS selector, as one tool: action is click or fill, and params carries selector (and value, for fill). click and fill take the same actions with labels, refs, frames and pages; prefer them.

action.description: "click" to click an element, "fill" to type text into an input field.

params.description: Action parameters. For click: {"selector": "button.submit"}. For fill: {"selector": "input[name=email]", "value": "user@example.com"}.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element.

value.description: Text to type into the element (fill only).

name: interact
title: Click or fill by selector
